def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    d = d.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # fix island label variants
    d['island'] = d['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    d['island'] = d['island'].replace({'Dram': 'Dream', 'Torgerson': 'Torgersen'})
    # fix sex label variants
    d['sex'] = d['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': None})
    # numeric coercion for text-encoded numeric columns
    for col in ['body_mass_g', 'flipper_length_mm', 'year']:
        if col in d.columns:
            d[col] = pd.to_numeric(d[col].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # enforce valid ranges
    d = d[(d['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (d['bill_length_mm'] <= 60)]
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d[d['species'] == 'Adelie']
    d = d.dropna(subset=['island', 'bill_length_mm'])
    g = d.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean()
    return {k: round(float(v), 4) for k, v in g.items()}
